msg: SECURITY amend (FROM bypass; reproduced on main here: FROM $'run-suite\n' stores a clean from=run-suite signal green, rc 0; FROM with \x01 stores an UNPARSABLE line, rc 0 — a silent drop; FROM 'run-suite ' (trailing space) stores 'run-suite ' — not machine-forged but identical on log/board). RULE: (1) CHECK WHAT YOU STORE — validate the value exactly as it will be written, never the raw arg before sanitizing; (2) identity fields get an ALLOWLIST, not a control-char denylist: FROM and TO must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:@-]{0,63}$ (TO may also be '*'); anything else is malformed, rc 2, nothing recorded — this closes newline/CR, every control byte, spaces, and non-ASCII lookalikes in one rule; (3) the reserved-identity check runs AFTER that, on the validated value; (4) MCP: the same grammar for from/to (one vocabulary, ADR 0028), then the exact reserved check; (5) EXTRA integers as JSON numbers -?(0|[1-9][0-9]*) — agreed. Pins I5/I6 should include: newline, CR, \x01, trailing space, a non-ASCII hyphen (U+2011) in FROM -> rc 2 nothing recorded; existing ids (macM1-lane2, session_01Kq..., navigator-delegation-setup) still accepted.
